organization.description: Company or organization name. Example: "Builder LLC"

create_date.description: Creation date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2026-06-29"

type.description: Line item type. Example: 0 for Item

name.description: Line item name. Example: "Test Estimate Line"

staffid.description: Staff member ID. Defaults to 1 (account owner).

categoryid.description: Expense category ID. If omitted, the first available category is fetched and used.

amount.description: Monetary amount as a string. Example: "150.00"

date.description: Expense date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2026-06-29"

create_date.description: Invoice creation date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-15"

type.description: Line type. 0 for item, 1 for unbilled expense. Example: 0

actions.description: Create a payment against an invoice.
actions.name: create-payment

invoiceid.description: Invoice ID to apply the payment to. Example: 453877

date.description: Payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-15"

client_id.description: Client ID to bill for the project. Example: 567521

fixed_price.description: Flat-rate amount charged to the client. Example: "500.00"

rate.description: Hourly rate of the project. Example: "75.00"

internal.description: Whether the project is internal to the company.

is_logged.description: Whether the time entry is logged.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work started. Example: "2024-01-01T10:00:00Z"

duration.description: Duration of the time entry in seconds. Example: 3600

client_id.description: Client ID associated with the time entry. Example: 567521

identity_id.description: Identity ID of the teammate logging the time.

project_id.description: Project ID associated with the time entry.

service_id.description: Service ID associated with the time entry.

task_id.description: Task ID associated with the time entry.

billable.description: Whether the entry can be added to an invoice.

billed.description: Whether the entry has already been billed.

internal.description: Whether the time entry is internal (not assigned to a client).

estimateId.description: FreshBooks estimate ID to archive. Example: "567521"

projectId.description: The project ID to delete. Example: "123"

timeEntryId.description: The ID of the time entry to delete. Example: "123456"

id.description: The ID of the deleted time entry.

accountId.description: Alphanumeric account identifier for /accounting/ endpoints. Example: "ZyQ04o"

businessId.description: Numeric business identifier for /projects/ and /timetracking/ endpoints. Example: 14719708

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Send an invoice by email or mark it as sent.
actions.name: send-invoice

invoice_id.description: The ID of the invoice to send. Example: 453877

method.description: How to send the invoice. Use "email" to email the client, or "mark_as_sent" to mark as sent without emailing.

estimateId.description: The ID of the estimate to update. Example: 2201278

amount.description: Expense amount object with amount string and currency code. Example: {"amount": "25.00", "code": "USD"}

vis_state.description: Visibility state: 0 for active, 1 for deleted

customerid.description: Client ID to associate with the invoice.

project_id.description: The unique id of the project to update. Example: 779597

fixed_price.description: Used for flat-rate projects. Represents the amount being charged

complete.description: Whether the project has been completed

internal.description: Clarifies that the project is internal

rate.description: The hourly rate of the project

billing_method.description: The method of payment for the project

note.description: Updated note for the time entry

project_id.description: Project ID associated with the time entry

is_logged.description: Whether the time entry is logged
